title: 云巨头财报惊逆转：AI需求终于兑现，增长近40%
speaker: Maribel Lopez

segments.en: In the U.S. market, everybody was holding their breath on Microsoft and Amazon's revenue because if that didn't come in, there was going to be an extreme validation of the concept that maybe the AI boom was over, that we were spending too much money, that we had to hold off on capacity planning.
segments.zh: 在美国市场，大家都在屏息等待微软和亚马逊的营收，因为如果数据不佳，就可能印证AI热潮已过、投入过多、需要暂缓产能规划的观点。

segments.en: The sales there came in better than expected. The discussion about demand going forward became better than expected, which leads to really the semiconductor industry getting a boom and the whole global economy saying that there's still opportunity for AI sales as we move forward.
segments.zh: 实际销售好于预期，对未来需求的讨论也好于预期，这带动半导体行业景气，全球经济也认为AI销售仍有增长空间。

segments.en: So Maribel, part of, I guess, the second part to that question would be how much of the are they monetizing AI question that was answered so far?
segments.zh: 那么Maribel，第二个问题就是，AI变现的问题目前回答了多少？

segments.en: I think we came in better than expected. We've heard the story for several quarters now about we're going to invest, we're going to invest and then we're going to see some enterprise buying demand.
segments.zh: 我认为结果好于预期。过去几个季度我们一直听到要投入、再投入，然后才会看到企业采购需求的故事。

segments.en: So when you look at the size of the cloud services that we were going into to still see, you know, 30s, almost 40% growth in a hyperscaler at this stage of the game was actually very encouraging that the demand that they have been talking about was actually started to be monetized with people running AI workloads in the cloud.
segments.zh: 所以当你看到云服务的规模，超大规模云厂商在这个阶段仍有30%到近40%的增长，这非常鼓舞人心，说明他们之前谈到的需求确实开始通过人们在云端运行AI工作负载而变现。
